hero.title: 1\. Why Study Physiotherapy in Finland?
hero.subtitle: Pursue high-standard Physiotherapy education in Finland, focusing on physical functional capacity, neurological rehabilitation, and health technology. Benefit from innovative clinical simulation environments and progressive Nordic healthcare methodologies.

overview: Studying Physiotherapy in Finland can be an excellent option for international students looking for a modern, practical and internationally oriented healthcare education. Finland is known for its strong higher education system, advanced healthcare infrastructure and emphasis on practical learning.
Explore world-class Finnish research universities and universities of applied sciences (UAS) offering English-taught degrees, high innovation ranking, and generous scholarships.
